# Hand-labelled definitions of the base corpus, one per line: path|name|bucket.
#
# A function is a callable declared WITH a body: a function, a method or a
# constructor. A signature without a body (an interface or trait member) is
# not a function definition. A type is a struct, class, enum, trait or
# interface. Packages, variables, fields and Terraform or Helm constructs are
# not labelled: the production detectors read only functions and types.
